note: Splunk serves AgentSec dashboard JavaScript from /<locale>/static/@<splunk build>.<push>-<app build>/app/agentsec/<file>. The app build segment is [install] build in splunk_app/agentsec/default/app.conf and is the only part AgentSec controls. Changing a file under splunk_app/agentsec/appserver/static/ without changing the app build leaves the deployed URL identical, so a browser can keep an older cached copy. Update with: python3 scripts/static_cache_identity.py --write
